issues.where: beat 7, 0:44.90 to 0:45.70, after the shredder reveal
issues.what: The payoff is easy to miss at playback speed: the entered fields clear and the small message asking the user to re-enter everything appears less than a second before the page starts turning away.
issues.fix: Hold the full page front-on after the reset and give the re-entry message a clear heading or callout. Take time for this hold from the preceding slow feed if the sequence length is fixed.

issues.what: The last-second flipper save is framed from high and wide. Most of the Street tier is in view, while the ball and the catching flipper sit small near the lower edge.
issues.fix: Drop the camera to just above flipper height and tighten on the ball's approach, the catching flipper, and the drain it narrowly misses.

issues.what: A foreground bumper overlaps the ball and crowds the lobby entrance, while the tower runs out of the top of frame. The door slam is not the shot's clearest action.
issues.fix: Shift sideways to give the ball and both door edges a clear line of sight, then tilt or widen enough to establish the tower above them.

issues.what: The tray and the pursuing balls are visible, but the framing gives almost the entire Office tier equal weight. The tray mouth and start of the chase are small and off-center.
issues.fix: Start tighter on the tray mouth and pan with the cursor ball, keeping the pursuing balls and their path in the same shot.

issues.where: cameras 2, 3 and 4, lower edge of each overhead tier view
issues.what: The flippers fit but the center drain and the bottom boundary are clipped, so none of the three views quite reads as a complete tier in one screen.
issues.fix: Pull back or re-center each overhead camera to include the drain and lower boundary with a small margin.

issues.where: beat 4, 0:32.17 to 0:33.50, email field and validation callout
issues.what: The moving Invalid email callout passes over the address itself, making it hard to see the valid-looking address and its rejection together.
issues.fix: Let the callout move beside or below the field, preserving the address and keeping the rejection readable at the same time.

issues.where: camera 10, Office tier bumper labels and bottom edge
issues.what: Pizza Party, Team Building and Reply All are difficult to read against the playfield, and the centered feature below Unemployment Office is cut off in what is meant to be the full map.
issues.fix: Increase the label size and text contrast, and give the bottom of the map enough inset to show the complete feature.
